column1: # Forms the analyzer reads as text has them, though TDK spells them otherwise: word, root, tags
# (as paradigms.tsv). tests/morphology_gold.rs checks that `analyze` has the reading and that
# `analyze_standard` has none: they are no spellings to the spell checker, the grammar rules or
# --- a name with its capital and a consonant-initial case or copula ending, written without the
# apostrophe: read at a lower score when nothing else matches (plan step D1)
# --- numerals written as one word (plan step D4)
